# webtables/index

> Indexing: `x[i]` on a `str` or a slice, with a bounds check.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/index.pkg) · translates [std/index](../std/index.md)

The helpers take the operand and the index, evaluated in that order,
compare the index unsigned against the length, and call
`$__pk_panic_index` from [panic](panic.md) if it is out of range. The
`addr` sections give the element's address, for assignment and `&`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when x str`

```nasm
(call $__pk_index_str
{x}
{i}
)
@panic
```

### `emit when self size 1`

```nasm
(call $__pk_index_b
{x}
{i}
)
@panic
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(call $__pk_index_w
{x}
{i}
)
@panic
```

### `emit addr when self size 1`

```nasm
(call $__pk_index_ab
{x}
{i}
)
@panic
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
(call $__pk_index_aw
{x}
{i}
)
@panic
```

Includes: [webtables/panic](panic.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
(func $__pk_check (param $x i64) (param $i i64) (param $n i64)
(if (i64.ge_u (local.get $i) (local.get $n)) (then (call $__pk_panic_index))))
(func $__pk_index_str (param $x i64) (param $i i64) (result i64)
(call $__pk_check (local.get $x) (local.get $i) (i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $x))))
(i64.load8_u offset=8 (i32.wrap_i64 (i64.add (local.get $x) (local.get $i)))))
(func $__pk_index_ab (param $x i64) (param $i i64) (result i64)
(call $__pk_check (local.get $x) (local.get $i) (i64.load offset=8 (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $x))))
(i64.add (i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $x))) (local.get $i)))
(func $__pk_index_aw (param $x i64) (param $i i64) (result i64)
(call $__pk_check (local.get $x) (local.get $i) (i64.load offset=8 (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $x))))
(i64.add (i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $x))) (i64.shl (local.get $i) (i64.const 3))))
(func $__pk_index_b (param $x i64) (param $i i64) (result i64)
(i64.load8_u (i32.wrap_i64 (call $__pk_index_ab (local.get $x) (local.get $i)))))
(func $__pk_index_w (param $x i64) (param $i i64) (result i64)
(i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (call $__pk_index_aw (local.get $x) (local.get $i)))))
```
